title: CompilerSutra Weekly — #003, November 21 2026
week_overview: 01 — The biggest development: Skip more tests that don't work with WebAssembly. These are breaking the new Green Dragon matrix bot that now also tests WebAssembly. Engineering focus: Runtime & Toolchain (WebAssembly) … (Runtime & Toolchain)

02 — Backend and code generation: Avoid false dependency for BSF. BSF, like BSR, leaves its destination unmodified when the source is zero, so the hardware treats the destination as an input. Engineering… (Backend)

03 — GPU / accelerator compilers: Add an async barrier arrival workaround. Async barrier arrivals on gfx1250 and gfx1251 need a replay workaround when XNACK is enabled or unspecified. Engineering focus: Backend… (Backend)

04 — Also on the radar: Fix moveInstrNotifier on empty DAG. This patch fixes a crash inside an assertion in the DAG move instruction notifier, when the DAG was empty. Engineering focus: Middle-end … (Middle-end)

05 — Frontend and language infrastructure: Implement relative-vtable-lookups. This patch handles lookups from a relative-vtable. Engineering focus: Frontend — Languages teams should confirm behavior in the linked… (Frontend)
